Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> National Mahama holds discussions with UK Foreign Secretary Source : GNA 23 October 2026 5:05am Audio By Carbonatix
President John Dramani Mahama has held discussions with Mr Ed Miliband, the United Kingdom Secretary of State for Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Affairs in London.
A statement issued by Ghana’s Presidency said the discussions centred on strengthening the historic partnership between Ghana and the United Kingdom, with particular focus on expanding trade and investment, promoting sustainable economic growth, and advancing shared global priorities.
The President reaffirmed Ghana’s commitment to building strategic international partnerships that promote shared prosperity.
